title: Add generic versus fast-path modem benchmarks
description:
Measure the reference arbitrary-constellation path against the Gray-QAM fast path and capture the main hot loops.

## Success Criteria

- [ ] Benchmarks compare the generic modem path against the optimized Gray-QAM fast path.
- [ ] The benchmark set captures the main hot loops that matter for future optimization work.
- [ ] Results are usable as a baseline for later SIMD and accelerator tuning.

## Notes

This task provides the performance baseline needed by the epic success criteria.
